title: Raft-replicated timestamp oracle (TSO) as the transaction timestamp source
context: TASK-0009 compared a centralised TSO (Percolator/TiDB style) with HLC plus uncertainty intervals (CockroachDB style). REQ-0014 AC2 requires 0 anomalies under clock skew; v1 is single-region (AZ-level placement, REQ-0001).
decision: Transactions take start_ts and commit_ts from a strictly monotonic TSO on the meta-range leaseholder, persisting a high-water mark through Raft and serving batched timestamps from memory. Combined with Percolator-style prewrite and commit-time read-set validation this gives (strict) serializability with no dependence on clock synchronisation. Revisit if multi-region writes become a requirement.
